project.name: Belton Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 1 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-11: 8 of 9 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

touristAppeal.label: Not a tourist town
touristAppeal.summary: Belton has recorded local interest, but its current in-boundary visitor offer does not meet the threshold for a tourist-town rating.

townGuide.headline: A practical local guide to Belton
townGuide.intro: Belton has a modest visitor offer within its active settlement boundary. The guide records defensible heritage and practical stops without presenting the place as a destination.
